picks.headline: Amazon's Prime Video Is Using AI to Lip-Sync Actors' Mouths in Dubbed Titles, Starting With German Series 'Maxton Hall'
picks.excerpt: Prime Video is applying AI visual dubbing to alter actors' mouth movements so English dubs match the dialogue, beginning with the German series 'Maxton Hall.' It moves lip-sync dubbing from beta demos into a streamer's shipping localization pipeline.
picks.rationale: AI visual dubbing crosses from demo reel into a major streamer's shipping localization pipeline, which resets what delivery specs and dub budgets look like.

picks.headline: Nice Touch V2: an AI edit assistant for professional editors
picks.excerpt: Nice Touch shipped V2, a full rebuild of its AI workflow/edit assistant that runs inside Adobe Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve. The company says the redesign came out of more than 300 conversations with editors, producers, post supervisors and studio owners.
picks.rationale: A ground-up rebuild of an assistant that lives inside Premiere and Resolve — the most directly installable change to an editor's day in this batch.

picks.headline: Beeble introduces SwitchX 2.0 with native 4K, longer shots and more
picks.excerpt: Beeble's SwitchX 2.0 lets filmmakers and VFX artists change lighting, backgrounds and props in existing footage, now at native 4K, 10-bit, and up to 20-second clips at 24fps. The update also improves camera tracking, motion fidelity and lip sync.
picks.rationale: Native 4K, 10-bit and 20-second shots push in-footage relighting past demo length into something you can actually cut into a delivery.

picks.headline: Maxon to Preview Fall Cinema 4D, ZBrush and Redshift Updates at IBC2026
picks.excerpt: Maxon's October ecosystem release previews new 3D world-building in Cinema 4D, a desktop-and-iPad ZBrush sculpting workflow, procedural fur, and AI-powered relighting in Redshift. Booth visitors got the early look September 11-14.
picks.rationale: Names what lands in Cinema 4D, ZBrush and Redshift in October — including AI relighting — early enough for 3D teams to plan the upgrade.

picks.headline: Acon Acoustica 8 Provides AI-Assisted Audio Workflow Tools
picks.excerpt: Acon Digital released Acoustica 8, adding AI-assisted tools to its audio editing, restoration and mastering suite. The company frames the release as a direct response to technical problems raised by working audio post professionals.
picks.rationale: Restoration and mastering AI aimed at problems audio post actually reported, keeping the batch from being all picture-side tooling.
